supect_following_conditions.label: Do you know or suspect that you have any of the following conditions? (Select all that apply)

choices.label: Endometriosis - a condition where tissue similar to the lining of the womb (uterus) grows outside the uterus, often causing pain, heavy periods, and sometimes infertility

Adenomyosis - a condition where tissue that normally lines the womb (uterus) grows into the muscular wall of the uterus, often causing heavy or painful periods, an enlarged uterus, and sometimes infertility.

Uterine fibroids - non-cancerous (benign) growths or tumors in or around the womb. They are very common and can cause heavy or long periods, pelvic pain, pressure, frequent urination, and sometimes infertility.

Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome -  - a hormonal and metabolic condition that affects women of childbearing age. It can cause irregular or infrequent periods, excess hair growth on the face or body, acne, weight gain, and sometimes infertility.
PMDD - a severe form of premenstrual syndrome (PMS) that causes extreme mood changes and physical symptoms in the week or two before your period.
